projectAdmin.title: Projects and scoped keys
projectAdmin.scope: Root credentials create or suspend projects. Project administrators manage only their own keys. Read/write keys cannot administer projects. Revocation takes effect immediately.
projectAdmin.failed: Administration failed. Check that this credential has the required permissions.
projectAdmin.unknown: The request outcome is unknown. Refresh and inspect the current projects/keys before taking another action; the request is not automatically repeated.
projectAdmin.tokenOnce: Copy this token now. It is shown only for this creation and is not saved by Inspector. Closing this view loses it.
projectAdmin.confirmDescription: Suspending a project or revoking a key immediately affects its clients. This does not delete stored memories. Revoking the current key may also disconnect Inspector.

provenance.title: Sources, evidence & history
provenance.scope: Deleting messages removes their evidence across every blob in this source and rebuilds affected memories. Event deletion remains event-only.
provenance.failed: The operation failed; no success was confirmed.
provenance.processing: The server is still processing; query this operation without replaying it.
provenance.unknown: The result is unconfirmed. Keep this key and query it; do not resubmit the write.
provenance.support: Support groups (+ requires all; | means independent support)
provenance.messages: Select source message IDs whose contributions should be deleted
provenance.awaitConfirmation: Memory changes are awaiting confirmation. Open Sources & history to query the operation.
provenance.confirmDescription: Facts and evidence are updated first. Profiles and events are rebuilt asynchronously from remaining facts and may temporarily show older text, including after a maintenance failure. This is not event deletion. Rolling back Inspector cannot restore deleted evidence.

maintenance.title: Derived memory maintenance
maintenance.stale: Facts are already committed; older profile/event text may remain until maintenance succeeds. A maintenance failure does not require importing messages again.
maintenance.automaticRetry: Eligible for automatic recovery within the attempt budget
maintenance.manualRecovery: Automatic retries stopped; fix the cause, then resume this flush explicitly
